sn45.4:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasmayam nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthim piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3.
sn45.4:1.3: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando Jānusoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena Sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ ||
sn45.4:1.4: setā sudam assā yuttā honti setālaṅkārā seto ratho setaparivāro setā rasmiyo setā patodalaṭṭhi setaṃ chattaṃ setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ setāni vatthāni setā upāhanā || setāya sudaṃ vālavījaniyā vījīyati || ||
sn45.4:1.5: Tam enaṃ jano disvā evam āha ||
sn45.4:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn45.4:3.1: Idhāham bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthim piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ ||
sn45.4:3.2: addasaṃ khoham bhante Jānusoniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena Sāvatthiyā niyyāyantam ||
sn45.4:3.3: setā sudam assā yuttā honti setālaṅkarā seto ratho setaparivāro setā rasmiyo setā patodalaṭṭhi setaṃ chattaṃ setam uṇhīsaṃ setāni vatthāni setā upāhanā setāya sudam vālavījaniyā vījiyyati ||
sn45.4:3.4: tam enaṃ jano disvā evam āha ||
sn45.4:3.7: sakkā nu kho bhante imasmim dhammavinaye brahmayānam paññāpetun ti || ||
sn45.4:4.2: Imasseva kho etam Ānanda ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanam
sn45.4:4.3: brahmayānaṃ iti pi dhammayānam iti pi anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti pi || || 5.
sn45.4:5.1: Sammādiṭṭhi Ānanda bhāvitā bahulīkatā rāgavinayapariyosānā hoti || dosavinayapariyosānā hoti || mohavinayapariyosānā hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.2: Sammāsaṅkappo Ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti || dosavinayapariyosāno hoti || mohavinayapariyosāno hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.3: Sammāvācā Ānanda bhāvitā bahulīkatā rāgavinayapāriyosānā hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosānā hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.4: Sammākammanto Ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosāno hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.5: Sammāājīvo Ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosāno hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.6: Sammāvāyāmo Ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosāno hoti || ||
sn45.4:5.7: Sammāsati Ānanda bhavitā bahulīkatā rāgavinayapariyosānā hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosānā hoti ||
sn45.4:5.8: Sammāsamādhi Ānando bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti || dosa || pa || mohavinayapariyosāno hoti || ||
sn45.4:6.1: Iminā kho etam Ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā imassevetam ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanam
sn45.4:6.2: brahmayānam iti pi dhammayānam iti pi anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti pīti || ||
